title: Mynaa
desc: To avoid getting into an unwanted marriage, Mynaa escapes with her childhood love, Suruli, and plans to marry him. Along the way, they face many problems and fate has something drastic in store.

title: FIR
desc: Young Irfan Ahmed finds himself caught in inexplicable circumstances tied to his religion, but the media hastily labels him a terrorist, painting him as the embodiment of evil.

title: Eleven
desc: A seasoned police officer begins an investigation after a series of gruesome murders targeting twins comes to light. However, he soon encounters a sinister game of psychological manipulation.

title: DeAr
desc: Marital bliss is disrupted for a newlywed pair when the husband, a sensitive sleeper, discovers his wife's snoring problem.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.

title: Poraali
desc: Kumaran and Nallavan relocate to Chennai to start a new life. Though they get employed and are successful in the beginning, eventually their past comes to haunt them.

title: Ganesh
desc: Ganesh, a young man, is forced to pretend to be in love with Divya. However, trouble ensues when he truly starts liking her and must convince her of his feelings.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Padayottam
desc: Udayan is crowned to rule over his uncle's kingdom. While he strives to handle the responsibility, he attempts to overcome challenges of people who are against his accession.

title: Karuppu Durai
desc: Karuppu Durai, an elderly man, runs away from home after learning his family's plan to kill him using euthanasia. His life takes a turn when he meets a young, orphaned boy.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Asuran
desc: A farmer goes on the run with his family as he is compelled to protect his son, who has murdered a wealthy upper-caste landlord in a fit of vengeance.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.
